releaseNotes: Compact, wide 2-column Update dialog matching Help pop-up width to eliminate whitespace
Added 'Reload App' option in update pop-up to refresh cached assets with one click
Unsaved changes protection: warns and confirms before loading another character or creating a new sheet if open edits exist
Re-established Sustained as a +0 extra tradeoff for Regeneration with official 4th Edition rules text
Updated all 82 power modifier descriptions and full rule entries directly from 4th Edition rules without paraphrasing
Fixed 0-cost modifier calculation across all powers (e.g. Sustained on Protection, Strength-Based on Damage)
Enhanced power effect configurations across all powers with full options (resist, condition degrees, media, senses, subPowers, notes, and ranks)
Configured Feature as a standard rank-adjustable effect with complete presets and descriptions
Fixed Immunity configuration presets (Fortitude Immunity, Will Immunity, Save Immunities) to properly configure sub-options, ranks, and PP costs
Real-time PP budget tracker on Basics tab highlighting in red when exceeding allowed limit
Save validation warning and confirmation prompt whenever saving a character over its PP limit
Automatic update check at program startup displaying update dialog when a newer version is found
Fixed duplicate companion creation bug when adding an alternate form
Streamlined form options by treating Mecha as Alternate Forms per M&M 4E rules
Added 'Check for Updates' function in Main Menu for local installations
Options popup now displays side-by-side with Main Menu instead of overlapping it
Interactive Hero Point and Power Point trackers with steppers on History tab
Renamed Background tab to History with updated navigation and help guide
Smart travel mode stats: Flight and Space Speed only display on Basics tab when active
Skills and Advantages tabs converted to clean, non-collapsible panels
Enforced 10pt minimum font accessibility floor across entire application
